name: Product size chart
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product size chart. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Chart source
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for chart source. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Chart image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Rich text chart
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Metafield namespace
settings.how: Advanced: enter the namespace of an existing Shopify metafield definition, such as custom. It must match the definition exactly. Pair it with the corresponding key; this setting does not create a definition.

settings.label: Metafield key
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists.
